findings.evidence: `grep -n 'namespace LinearMap.BilinForm' EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/LightConeBasis.lean` -> line 70; its imports are `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Orthogonal` and `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Projection` (lines 8-9), whereas `DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:8` is `public import Mathlib`. `projOrthogonal`'s statements mention only `g`, `u`, `v`, no `DisKinematics` field.
findings.fix: Move `projOrthogonal` and its lemma family, and `apply_sub_smul_pair`, into a new `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/` module (e.g. `OrthogonalProjection.lean`) in the `LinearMap.BilinForm` namespace, alongside `LightConeBasis.lean`; have `DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean` import it. No call site changes: `Bilin` is a reducible `abbrev` for `LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V` (line 36), so `g.projOrthogonal u` and `g.apply_sub_smul_pair` still resolve by dot notation, and the reuse rubric's one-`Bilin`-home request is unaffected. `rankOne`, `IsIsometry` and `reflect`, which this PR also relocated into this file (lines 141-205), are the same generic material and belong in the same move.
findings.issue: `Bilin.projOrthogonal` and its nine lemmas (`projOrthogonal_apply`, `_orthogonal`, `_apply_self`, `_eq_self_iff`, `_projOrthogonal`, `ker_`, `range_`, `_pairing`, `_smul`, lines 66-139) plus the relocated `apply_sub_smul_pair` (line 55) are pure bilinear-form linear algebra with no DIS content, placed in a DIS kinematics module. The repo already has a home for this: `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/LightConeBasis.lean` (namespace `LinearMap.BilinForm`, line 70) states the two-vector analogue `transverseProj` with the same API shape (`isProj_transverseProj`, `transverseProj_transverseProj_eq`, `ker_transverseProj_eq_longitudinal`, `bilinForm_eq_plus_mul_minus_add`) over an arbitrary commutative ring. This PR gives `projOrthogonal` two consumers in two different areas (`Tensors.pTransverse`, `Jets.Frame.spatialPart`), confirming it is not DIS-specific.

summary: Jets/Frame/ placement and the Witness import are correct as the roadmap and the author's replies argue; those earlier findings are withdrawn. The new generic bilinear-form projector API (Bilin.projOrthogonal and friends) is buried in a DIS kinematics module when the repo already has EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/ holding exactly this kind of declaration.
